Dense-range factorization of L^alpha-cV gives the exact finite-rank threshold 1/lambda_max(W^{1/2}G_RW^{1/2}). Riemann-Lebesgue for alpha<1/2, the reciprocal-theta split and cosine-difference integral at alpha=1/2, and a uniformly integrable u^{2-2alpha} near zero / u^{-2alpha} at infinity domination for alpha>1/2 prove all three regimes. The cosine-difference integral has denominator 2Gamma(1+beta)sin(pi beta/2), which gives the alpha=1 limiting kernel min(x,y). The Gram representation proves strict positive definiteness and its explicit formula gives strictly positive off-diagonal entries. Two-by-two determinant/eigenvalue analysis proves the pairwise cooperative window for all fractional orders above 1/2.
